why: Identified as Enchanted Harbour (Google: 'Enchanted Harbor Marina', place point 53.755477,-105.2868332, on the causeway pin's marina basin; Resort Village of Candle Lake business directory: 'Enchanted Harbour ... #60 Hwy 265 ... RV Park & Marina', 306-514-0114). The village's RV-parks page (candlelake.ca/p/rv-parks-, read 2026-11-19) lists it among the 'Seasonal RV Parks'; Candle Lake Marketplace posts (Google snippets, read 2026-11-19) sell trailers 'on rented seasonal lot at Enchanted Harbour Marina Candle Lake Sk lot 16' and '5th wheel trailer on leased [lot] at Candle Lake - Enchanted Harbour Marina', and 'A lot at Site 31, Enchanted Harbour Marina ... for sale for $23,000. It includes a trailer' (2026-04-29). No website, no posted nightly rate, no booking engine; Google 4.8 (5) with no phone. Fails test 2 (no nightly sales) and has no price or presence indicator.
name: Enchanted Harbour (Enchanted Harbor Marina)
flags: IDENTITY: the trailer park + marina at the old 9166 pin (53.7561,-105.2852) is Enchanted Harbour. Esri z17 (rendered, 2026-11-19) shows a marina basin with a building and about 100+ closely packed trailers with decks west of it plus a fenced block of lots east of the basin: a lease park, not a campground.

NEIGHBOUR, also not a campground: Harbour View Marina & RV Park (~53.748,-105.2745, ~1.3 km SE on Hwy 265, harbourviewmarina.ca, 306-227-3748, Google 3.4 (5)) sells only 'RV Park Yearly Leased Sites': 28 lots 'Starting at $3,499/Season' (2026 lot list prices $5,499-$5,999), with a 2026 lease agreement. Don't add it if it ever comes up as a lead.

The village's page names eight private RV parks (Candle Lake Golf Resort, Enchanted Harbour, Golfers Haven, Harbourview, Holiday Acres, Mariners Cove, Shipman Contracting / formerly Misty Meadows, Nobles Point) under 'A listing of Seasonal RV Parks'. Candle Lake Golf Resort (RV Life 14924, 182 sites, 2*/$$$) is the only one with a sign of nightly RV sales; it was not part of this lead and I did not vet it.
